annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/525 correcting certain language versions of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/525 correcting certain language versions of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 105/3
named_instruments_referenced: EU Implementing Regulation 2019/947 on unmanned aircraft
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation correcting errors in the German and Portuguese language versions of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on unmanned aircraft operation rules. It makes no substantive change; the English version is unaffected, and the corrections apply retroactively from 31 December 2020.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects Portuguese version of Article 11(5)(a) and parts of the Annex of Regulation 2019/947
Applies from 31 December 2020 for legal certainty
Enters into force twentieth day after publication
Article 1 does not concern the English language
